title: 消费者兴趣提前出现，营销活动要不要前移？
topic: 根据搜索信号调整新品营销时间与全渠道配合

source.title: Inside Aritzia’s AI strategy that delivered record holiday sales
source.section: Inside Aritzia’s AI strategy that delivered record holiday sales
source.type: Think with Google 品牌营销与全渠道销售案例
source.context: Think with Google 发布的 Aritzia 品牌营销案例；本课练习围绕实际业务沟通任务。
paragraphs: The challenge? Stand out in a crowded women’s apparel market dominated by heritage labels and agile online players. To succeed, Aritzia needed to adjust its holiday playbook. With shopping journeys becoming less linear, the brand’s growth depended on meeting customers at every step — sparking awareness, creating demand, and converting intent at scale.

Aritzia embedded AI-powered solutions across the customer journey, turning predictive insights into proactive strategy. For example, when shopper signals revealed interest in its popular Super Puff jacket, spiking as early as June, the brand moved quickly to launch campaigns months before the expected season. Demand Gen and YouTube drove early awareness, while Search and Performance Max converted high-intent shoppers and optimized performance against profitability goals.

Building on this agile approach, Aritzia tested an “omni-first” mindset with its campaigns, using tools like local inventory ads to connect digital influence with store sales and make every impression work harder across channels.

The strategy delivered record-breaking results. Black Friday 2024 became the company’s best online sales day ever, and the Super Puff campaign led to a 55% year-over-year increase in demand. Aritzia’s strategic use of Search and Performance Max fueled a 42% lift in e-commerce net revenue in the fourth quarter.
translations: 挑战是什么？在由传统品牌和灵活的线上品牌主导、竞争拥挤的女装市场中脱颖而出。Aritzia 需要调整节日营销方案。随着消费者购物路径变得不再线性，品牌需要在每个阶段与顾客建立联系：激发认知、创造需求，并大规模转化购买意向。
Aritzia 将 AI 驱动的解决方案融入消费者购物旅程，把预测性洞察转化为主动营销策略。例如，消费者信号显示，大家对热门 Super Puff 羽绒服的兴趣最早在 6 月就开始上升。品牌迅速行动，在预期销售季节到来前几个月启动营销。Demand Gen 和 YouTube 用于提前建立认知，Search 和 Performance Max 则承接购买意向较强的消费者，并围绕盈利目标优化表现。
沿着这种灵活做法，Aritzia 在营销活动中测试“全渠道优先”思路，使用本地库存广告等工具，把数字渠道带来的影响与门店销售连接起来，让每次曝光在不同渠道发挥更大作用。
这项策略带来了创纪录的结果。2024 年黑五成为公司历来线上销售最好的一天；Super Puff 活动带动需求同比增长 55%。Aritzia 使用 Search 和 Performance Max，使第四季度电商净收入增长 42%。
fullTextParagraphs: Canadian fashion brand Aritzia — known for viral products and elevated flagship stores — set its sights on scaling in the U.S. without sacrificing profitability.

The challenge? Stand out in a crowded women’s apparel market dominated by heritage labels and agile online players. To succeed, Aritzia needed to adjust its holiday playbook. With shopping journeys becoming less linear, the brand’s growth depended on meeting customers at every step — sparking awareness, creating demand, and converting intent at scale.
The 2024 holiday peak became the ultimate proof point for its integrated model.

Aritzia embedded AI-powered solutions across the customer journey, turning predictive insights into proactive strategy. For example, when shopper signals revealed interest in its popular Super Puff jacket, spiking as early as June, the brand moved quickly to launch campaigns months before the expected season. Demand Gen and YouTube drove early awareness, while Search and Performance Max converted high-intent shoppers and optimized performance against profitability goals.

Building on this agile approach, Aritzia tested an “omni-first” mindset with its campaigns, using tools like local inventory ads to connect digital influence with store sales and make every impression work harder across channels.

The strategy delivered record-breaking results. Black Friday 2024 became the company’s best online sales day ever, and the Super Puff campaign led to a 55% year-over-year increase in demand. Aritzia’s strategic use of Search and Performance Max fueled a 42% lift in e-commerce net revenue in the fourth quarter.

After proving the value of digital on e-commerce and seeing an increase in return on ad spend for store sales influenced by digital channels, Aritzia has adopted an “omni-first” mindset for digital marketing campaigns. Tools like local inventory ads help to bridge the gap between online and in-store.
Google and YouTube helped Canadian clothing brand Aritzia break into the U.S. market and grow 5X faster than the average U.S. clothing brand.

Start earlier than expected. Audience signals don’t always match the retail calendar. Using AI-powered insights, Aritzia spotted early signals for its Super Puff jacket and pivoted fast, turning curiosity into conversion.

Make ‘omni-first’ a reality. Shoppers don’t distinguish between online and in-store experiences, and neither should your strategy. Aritzia’s use of local inventory ads shows how digital can fuel store sales and create a seamless experience.

Supercharge storytelling with AI. Performance data may be the foundation, but it’s the story that wins hearts (and sales). Aritzia proved that creative brand storytelling, backed by AI-driven optimization, can connect with shoppers at scale.

For Aritzia, what began as a bold bet to win in a crowded category has become a road map for sustained, profitable growth, powered by AI, backed by digital, and built to adapt to the fast-changing fashion landscape. For marketers heading into peak shopping season, its story is a blueprint: Anticipate demand, connect every channel, and let AI amplify creativity and results.

notes.meaning: 在消费者购物旅程的不同阶段与他们建立联系。
notes.explain: awareness、demand、intent、conversion 对应认知、需求、购买意向和转化。
notes.example: Our campaign meets customers at every step of the buying journey.

notes.phrase: shopper signals revealed interest in its popular Super Puff jacket, spiking as early as June
notes.meaning: 消费者对 Super Puff 外套的兴趣信号最早在 6 月就开始上升。
notes.explain: spiking as early as June 表示关注度提前在 6 月上升，为提前启动活动提供信号。
notes.example: Search interest in winter coats started rising in July.

notes.phrase: Black Friday 2024 became the company’s best online sales day ever
notes.meaning: 2024 年黑五成为公司历来线上销售最好的一天。

notes.example: The promotion became our best online sales day of the year.

scenario.title: 冬季新品：搜索热度比零售日历更早出现
english: Searches for your winter jacket begin rising in June, months before the usual campaign window.
The product sells online and in stores, but the current plan starts only when the season begins.
Recommend whether to move awareness earlier, explain how digital activity can support store sales, and name the results to track.
chinese: 冬季外套的搜索量在 6 月开始上升，比通常的营销窗口早几个月。
产品在线上和门店都有销售，但目前计划等到季节开始才启动。
请建议是否提前建立认知，说明数字营销如何支持门店销售，并提出要跟踪的结果。

firstAttempt.prompt: 消费者对冬季新品的搜索在夏天就开始上升。请用英文建议是否提前启动活动、说明线上和门店如何配合，并提出要观察的销售指标。
firstAttempt.sample: Search interest in the jacket is rising earlier than our retail calendar. I recommend starting awareness campaigns now, then using Search to reach shoppers with strong purchase intent. Local inventory ads can connect online interest to nearby store availability. We should track demand, online sales, store sales influenced by digital, and return on ad spend before scaling.
firstAttempt.rationale: 回答把提前出现的消费者信号转成时间建议，再说明线上兴趣怎样导向门店，并用销售及回报指标检验。

words.example: Shopper signals revealed interest in the new collection in July.
words.translation: 消费者行为信号显示，大家在 7 月就开始关注新系列。
words.note: 可包括搜索、浏览、收藏或购买行为等数据。

words.example: Search ads help us reach shoppers with strong purchase intent.
words.translation: 搜索广告帮助我们触达购买意向强的消费者。
words.note: intent 指行为意向；high-intent 表示离购买决策更近。

words.example: We will review return on ad spend by channel.
words.translation: 我们会按渠道复盘广告支出回报。
words.note: 常用 ROAS 表示，衡量广告投入带来的收入回报。

taskPhrases.meaning: 在预期销售季前几个月启动活动
taskPhrases.collocation: start a campaign months before + event
taskPhrases.example: We started the campaign months before the holiday season.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们在节日前几个月就启动了活动。

taskPhrases.meaning: 转化购买意向较强的消费者
taskPhrases.example: Search ads help convert high-intent shoppers.
taskPhrases.translation: 搜索广告有助于转化购买意向较强的消费者。

taskPhrases.word: connect digital influence with store sales
taskPhrases.meaning: 把线上营销带来的影响与门店销售联系起来
taskPhrases.example: Local inventory ads connect digital influence with store sales.
taskPhrases.translation: 本地库存广告能帮助我们把线上营销带来的影响与门店销售联系起来。

structure.original: With shopping journeys becoming less linear, the brand’s growth depended on meeting customers at every step — sparking awareness, creating demand, and converting intent at scale.
analysis: With + 名词 + becoming… 交代市场变化背景。
depended on 后接 meeting…，说明品牌增长取决于采取什么行动。
sparking、creating 和 converting 三个动名词并列，依次呈现营销目标。
structure.transfer: With customer demand shifting earlier, our launch depends on building awareness, capturing intent, and converting interest across channels.

rewrite.bad: People are interested, so let’s post more ads.
rewrite.good: Search interest in the jacket is rising earlier than our retail calendar. I recommend starting awareness campaigns now, using Search to reach high-intent shoppers and local inventory ads to connect them with nearby stores. We can track online sales, store sales influenced by digital, and return on ad spend.
rewrite.translation: 消费者对外套的搜索兴趣比零售日历预期更早上升。我建议现在开始建立认知，用搜索广告触达高意向消费者，再用本地库存广告把他们与附近门店连接起来。我们可以跟踪线上销售、数字渠道带动的门店销售和广告支出回报。
rewrite.pattern: [Shopper signal] is rising before [usual timing]. I recommend [early action], using [channel] to [goal]. We can track [online/store outcomes] and [return].

cloze.prompt: Shopper signals revealed ______ in the jacket as early as June.
cloze.why: reveal interest 表示显示消费者开始关注。
high-intent shoppers 指购买意向较强的消费者。

cloze.prompt: We will review return on ad ______ by channel.
cloze.why: return on ad spend 衡量广告投入回报。

choice.prompt: 羽绒服的搜索量在 6 月上升，但门店销售季节要到秋天。哪种计划最能利用这个信号？
options: Wait until autumn because the retail calendar is fixed.
Start awareness earlier, use search to reach high-intent shoppers, connect nearby inventory, and compare online and store results.
Move all budget to online sales and stop measuring store impact.
choice.why: 第二条把提前建立认知、承接购买意向、连接附近库存和线上线下指标串起来。

output.prompt: 顾客对礼品套装的搜索比去年提前两个月上升。请给营销团队写两三句：建议何时启动活动、如何配合门店，并说明要追踪什么。
output.sample: Search interest in the gift set is rising two months earlier than last year. I recommend starting awareness campaigns now and using local inventory information to connect online shoppers with nearby stores. We should track online demand, store sales influenced by digital, and return on ad spend before increasing the budget.
check: 引用提前出现的消费者信号
提出明确的启动时间和渠道配合
说明线上与门店的复盘指标

blockers: 人工听审音频，逐条确认与页面文字一致并检查语速、停顿和截断。
真实账号进度保存和生产环境逐期验收。
